extract_f0_from_audio: extract fundamental frequency contours from a mono audio waveform using the pYAAPT algorithm
align_f0_to_durations: align an F0 contour tensor to token-level durations by subsampling and computing segment means
normalize_f0_speaker_mean: normalize F0 values using per-speaker mean and standard deviation statistics loaded from a saved file
normalize_f0_prompt: normalize F0 values within a single prompt by subtracting the mean and optionally dividing by the standard deviation
quantize_f0_bins: quantize continuous F0 values into discrete bin indices using a precomputed set of bin boundaries
